ConfigBackup.title: ConfigBackup
ConfigBackup.description: Cloud-synced Flarial Client module configuration, HUD coordinates, crosshair, and pack preset backup owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this backup.

title.description: Human-readable name for the cloud backup snapshot.

description.description: Summary of active modules, profile, and settings stored in this backup.

configJson.description: Serialized Flarial Client module, HUD, crosshair, script, and profile configuration payload.

moduleCount.description: Count of enabled utility modules in this backup snapshot.

addonCount.description: Count of enabled Bedrock add-ons/resource packs in this backup snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/configBackups/{backupId}.description: Per-user cloud backups of Flarial Client module configurations and HUD layouts.
